Sourdough bread

Feed the starter twelve hours before baking. A lively starter doubles in size and smells pleasantly sour, which is the sign that the wild yeast is active.

Mix flour, water and salt, then fold the dough every thirty minutes. The loop of stretching and folding builds gluten strength without kneading.

Bake in a preheated dutch oven at 250 degrees for twenty minutes with the lid on, then uncover until deeply browned.
